newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates close lower at 20.25/21.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates close lower at 20.25/21.00 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished lower on Friday in a liquid market after Monday's 0.5 percent repo rate cuts, traders said.
"We expected the cuts as market rates were out of line with central bank rates," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates finished at 20.25 to 21 percent with most deals struck in the 21.5 to 22 percent range.

The National Bank of Hungary cut its overnight and one-week repo rates to 27.75 percent and reduced the one-week reverse repo facility to 21.75 percent while the one-month reverse repo was cut to 22.25 percent.
Traders said another 0.25 percent cut was likely in the first quarter of 1997.
In the short term, traders expect O/N rates to stay around their present level.
"Overnight rates will remain steady or possibly ease a bit," Kalman said.
